# E9h tables (generated by classify.py from results/key_classes.tsv; do not edit)

## 0. Read-supported somatic keys and the E1.1 calls

Read-supported somatic = `tumor_only` (the A1-read consensus occurs in HG008-T v3.2 and not in HG008-N v6.2). Two tests: `h30 earlier` = the offref_negatives_20260929 method (61-bp query, a 1-bp indel allowed in a hit); `h50 strict` = the whole 101-column tensor and no indel allowed (the E9d rule). Calls among the tumor-only keys: base = trained model at the PASS threshold t; rescue = off-reference rescue (`site10_high`, argmax); all_H = ch6 set to H, at t. `rescue calls: tumor-only / all` = how many of all the rescue's calls on these keys are read-supported somatic. All autosomes (chr1 in brackets).

## 1. Keys and queries

Keys = assembly off-reference somatic SNP keys with a tensor in the set (all autosomes). Query h30 = the A1-read consensus within +-30 columns of the site (the earlier method), h50 = +-50 (the whole tensor). A1 rows = sampled rows of the A1 block (median). Event kind = the event's allele in the HG008-N assembly frame; repeat context of the event in its HG008-N window (homopolymer >= 7 bp touching it, else a 2-6 bp unit repeat of >= 3 copies, else other).

## 4. Why the two hit rules differ

`earlier normal, indel-only` = keys that the earlier rule calls normal although every HG008-N hit has an insertion or deletion (a repeat-length difference). Transitions h30 earlier -> h30 strict. Tumor-only keys whose HG008-T hit is at the event's locus (`T at locus`).

| set | earlier normal, indel-only (h30 / h50) | h30 earlier -> strict | tumor_only with T at locus (h30 earlier / h30 strict / h50 strict) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HG008T_Illumina` | 37 / 57 | normal->neither 1, normal->tumor_only 38, tumor_only->neither 1 | 28 / 65 / 114 |
| `HG008T_PacBio` | 26 / 37 | normal->tumor_only 27, tumor_only->neither 3 | 19 / 43 / 72 |
| `HG008T_ONT` | 21 / 24 | normal->tumor_only 21, tumor_only->neither 4 | 22 / 39 / 51 |

| `HG008T_ONT_d46` | 19 / 22 | normal->tumor_only 20, tumor_only->neither 1 | 19 / 38 / 50 |
